objective: Discover a causal, cost-surviving four-asset intraday strategy whose account NAV geometric daily growth can reach at least 1% without liquidation or jackpot concentration.

extracted_principles: prefer the asset receiving abnormal attention and liquidity now rather than a permanently fixed symbol
distinguish genuine liquidity consumption from failed breakouts that trap aggressive participants
treat large aggressive flow with little price progress as absorption and require opposite-flow reacceptance

datasets.market: Official Binance Vision USD-M completed 5-minute klines for BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT
datasets.mark: Official Binance Vision USD-M completed 5-minute mark-price klines
datasets.funding: Official Binance Vision USD-M historical funding-rate events

information_contract.rolling_features: current observation excluded from every baseline and external-liquidity range
information_contract.funding: only unambiguous funding events strictly after entry bar and before exit bar are applied
information_contract.end_of_period: no forced liquidation; unresolved state is reported and blocks later entries
information_contract.global_state: at most one position across all four symbols

ATTENTION_BREAKOUT.description: cross-sectional abnormal quote-volume attention plus aligned breakout, close location and taker flow

ATTENTION_TRAP_REVERSAL.description: abnormal-attention external-liquidity sweep, close back inside, sweep-direction aggressive flow and opposite delivery

ATTENTION_ABSORPTION_REACCEPTANCE.description: abnormal-attention aggressive-flow event with low price progress followed by opposite body and flow reacceptance

gates.sealed_confirmation_open_condition: the development-selected frozen rule passes every validation gate without parameter changes

selection: Rank within each mechanism using development periods only; select at most one frozen rule per mechanism, then compare their frozen validation results. Never select using validation or confirmation outcomes.
